question: On 13 February 2025, the European Parliament adopted a resolution on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. However, massacres continue and M23 still occupies vast swathes of territory in North Kivu and South Kivu, thirty years after the start of the First Congo War. Can the VP/HR therefore say: 1.
what specific measures she has taken to follow up on this resolution, and with what results?
whether she intends to suspend the memorandum of understanding on raw materials concluded with Rwanda in view of Rwanda’s support for M23, as documented by the United Nations?
what direct sanctions have been adopted since February 2025 against Paul Kagame and those responsible for war crimes committed by M23?
